sources.notes: Generate and verify provenance, preserve source and lockfile evidence, and report the exact achieved track/level. SLSA does not replace vulnerability, license, credential, runtime, or financial-domain testing, and higher levels may depend on build infrastructure choices. Related project page: https://openssf.org/projects/slsa/ . Accessed 2026-07-15.
sources.selection_rationale: Provides staged integrity guarantees for source, builds, provenance, artifact verification, and release hardening without requiring a paid service.
sources.title: OpenSSF Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts specification version 1.2

sources.credibility_signals: Federal Reserve primary publication with a joint Federal Reserve/OCC/FDIC attachment and explicit supersession history.
sources.freshness_signals: Issued and last updated 2026-04-17; accessed 2026-07-15.
sources.notes: SR 26-2 supersedes SR 11-7 and SR 21-8. Its attachment is https://www.federalreserve.gov/supervisionreg/srletters/SR2602a1.pdf . It is most relevant to Federal Reserve-regulated banking organizations over $30 billion, is non-prescriptive, and excludes generative/agentic AI from its defined scope. Applying its principles to Market Squawk is a conservative implementation inference, not an applicability or compliance assertion. Accessed 2026-07-15.
sources.selection_rationale: Current guidance addresses model materiality, aggregate risk, effective challenge, development, validation, outcomes analysis, ongoing monitoring, inventory, documentation, governance, and vendor products.
sources.title: Federal Reserve, OCC, and FDIC SR 26-2 revised model-risk management guidance

sources.credibility_signals: Basel Committee publication hosted by the Bank for International Settlements and marked Current.
sources.freshness_signals: Issued 2018-10-17, status Current, and accessed 2026-07-15.
sources.notes: The selected principles supersede the 2009 version. They are high-level banking and supervisory guidance, not a prescribed VaR/expected-shortfall algorithm or a compliance standard for a local personal platform. Use them as an inferred design baseline for versioned scenarios, assumptions, governance, independent review, and decision use. Accessed 2026-07-15.
sources.selection_rationale: Provides a governance framework for multi-risk portfolio stress tests covering objectives, policies, process, methodology, resources, documentation, use, and oversight.
sources.title: Basel Committee current stress-testing principles
